description: was a known light cruiser.]] Light cruiser was a designation used for a variety of capital ships and warships in different classification systems. The Chiss Ascendancy utilized light cruisers within the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, with a pair of Chiss light cruisers participating in a battle over Sunrise against the Grysk Hegemony alongside a large Chiss fleet, and two small light cruisers used by the Chiss Xodlak family within their family fleet.
